faqItems.question: How do I install the Chrome extension and connect to the VPN?
faqItems.answer: Install the VPN extension for Chrome from the Chrome Web Store, add the VPN to Chrome, and open it from your browser toolbar. Choose a website or connection mode, select a VPN server or location when available, and click Connect to VPN. The Free plan is designed to let you start without a credit card.

faqItems.question: What is a free VPN proxy and how does this online VPN work?
faqItems.answer: This browser extension is an online VPN service and VPN proxy for supported browser traffic. It routes selected traffic through a remote VPN server to provide a protected connection and may mask your IP address. It is a browser VPN tool, not automatically a VPN app or VPN client for every device and application.

faqItems.question: Can I use this as a private VPN for anonymous browsing?
faqItems.answer: A private VPN can help protect supported browser traffic and hide your usual IP address from websites, but it cannot guarantee anonymous internet access. Accounts, cookies, fingerprinting, browser settings, and other services may still identify you. Use this as a privacy browser extension and continue following safe browsing practices.

faqItems.question: Does the VPN protect or hide my browsing history and prevent online tracking?
faqItems.answer: The extension can protect supported browser traffic, but it does not automatically hide browsing history stored in your browser, clear search history, block cookies, or prevent every form of online tracking. Review the privacy policy for data handling details and use separate cookie protection or tracker blocker tools when needed.

faqItems.question: Can the extension change my IP address or spoof my browser location?
faqItems.answer: When supported browser traffic is routed through a remote VPN server, websites may see a new IP address instead of your usual connection IP address. This can change the apparent location for that traffic, but it does not guarantee a fake location, browser location spoofing, geolocation spoofing, timezone spoofing, or a change to every device feature.

faqItems.question: Does the extension provide advanced encryption and WebRTC leak protection?
faqItems.answer: The extension is designed to protect supported browser traffic between your browser and its network service. Encryption can reduce exposure on shared networks, but users should not assume advanced encryption, military-grade encryption, SSL encryption, TLS encryption, WebRTC leak protection, or IP leak protection unless that feature is explicitly shown in the current extension settings. Continue using HTTPS, strong passwords, and multi-factor authentication.

faqItems.question: Does the service provide a no-logs VPN or store browsing history?
faqItems.answer: Do not assume this is a no logs VPN, no-log VPN, or VPN without logs based only on the extension. Our data handling practices are described in the current privacy policy. Review that policy for information collected, retained, and used, including browsing history, connection information, IP address data, session data, and personal data. The extension does not make users completely anonymous.

faqItems.question: Can a free VPN unblock websites or restricted content?
faqItems.answer: Routing browser traffic through another server may allow access to some blocked websites or restricted content, but the extension cannot guarantee that it will unblock any website, bypass censorship, bypass government censorship, bypass network blocks, or provide unrestricted internet access. Results depend on the website, network policy, local law, and service terms.

faqItems.question: Can I use the VPN for streaming, Netflix, YouTube, or gaming?
faqItems.answer: A VPN server may provide access to some online videos, music, or other regional content, but streaming services and games can detect or restrict VPN traffic. The extension cannot guarantee Netflix VPN, YouTube VPN, Hulu VPN, Spotify VPN, streaming VPN, or gaming VPN access. Availability, performance, local law, and service terms apply.

faqItems.question: Will a fast VPN improve browsing speed and provide stable access?
faqItems.answer: VPN speed depends on your network, server distance, server performance, server load, browser activity, and the destination website. A nearby location may provide faster browsing, but no fast VPN can guarantee the fastest VPN, high-speed VPN servers, accelerated browsing, faster page loading, fast streaming, or consistent VPN performance in every situation. Try another available location and disable conflicting proxy extensions.

faqItems.question: Can I choose from multiple VPN server locations?
faqItems.answer: If your plan includes location selection, open the extension and choose from the VPN server locations currently available there. A nearby VPN server may provide better performance, while another country-specific VPN location may change the apparent region of supported browser traffic. Availability and performance can vary; the extension does not promise a specific number of countries or servers.

faqItems.question: Does the VPN include ad blocking, malware protection, or anti-fingerprinting?
faqItems.answer: The extension's primary purpose is browser traffic protection and IP address masking. Do not assume that it includes an ad blocker, free ad blocker, malware blocker, tracker blocker, browser fingerprint protection, User-Agent Switcher, cookie blocker, kill switch, or protection from every online threat. Review the current feature list and use trusted security tools separately when needed.

faqItems.question: Does the extension protect every application, mobile device, or operating system?
faqItems.answer: No. This is a browser extension, so protection is limited to supported browser traffic and websites covered by your selected mode. It does not automatically protect Windows, Mac, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, iPhone, iPad, smart TV, router, desktop, mobile, smartphone, tablet, or other device-wide traffic unless a separate supported product is installed.

faqItems.question: Can I use the VPN on public Wi-Fi or while traveling?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Browser protection can help reduce the exposure of supported traffic on airport Wi-Fi, coffee shop Wi-Fi, hotel Wi-Fi, school Wi-Fi, office Wi-Fi, or other shared and unsecured networks. Confirm that the connection is active before entering sensitive information, and continue to use HTTPS and normal security practices. No VPN replaces device security or protects unrelated applications automatically.

faqItems.question: What are the Free and Premium VPN plan limits?
faqItems.answer: The Free plan provides browser protection for supported websites and features available in the current Free experience. Usage limits, available locations, session time, and connection options may apply. Premium may include broader browser coverage, more server locations, higher usage limits, or priority support. Review the current VPN pricing and Premium VPN plan details before subscribing; features can change.

faqItems.question: Why does my VPN connection disconnect or conflict with another proxy?
faqItems.answer: Disconnects can result from an unstable network, an unavailable server, browser restrictions, a usage limit, or another proxy or VPN extension. Check your internet connection, reopen the extension, disable other proxy extensions, and try another location. For proxy extension conflict resolution, include the affected website, browser version, connection mode, server location, and steps already tried when contacting support.

faqItems.question: How do automatic website protection and VPN split tunneling work?
faqItems.answer: Per-site protection applies the extension's browser connection to websites you select. Add a domain to your protected websites list and save it to enable automatic website protection or an automatic VPN connection when you visit that domain. Unrelated browser traffic continues through its normal connection. This is browser-based VPN split tunneling, not app-based VPN routing or a device-wide kill switch.

faqItems.question: How do I contact VPN customer service or technical support?
faqItems.answer: Search these help articles first, then contact support by email or use live chat when available. Include your browser version, operating system, affected website, connection mode, server location, and the steps you have already tried. Never send passwords, payment details, browsing history, or other sensitive information in a support request.
